content: vk-bootstrap (charles-lunarg/vk-bootstrap) is MIT licensed (confirmed via direct LICENSE.txt fetch). Latest version ~1.4.350 (tracks Vulkan SDK versioning). Small, focused utility for Instance/PhysicalDevice/Device/Queue bootstrap with an explicit InstanceBuilder::set_headless() that skips WSI/surface setup entirely -- purpose-built for exactly the headless-compute-node use case here. Trivial CMake integration (single small library target).
